asked.item: How to post as a YouTube Short instead of a normal video

verdict.reason: The help pages say YouTube automatically identifies Shorts by length (under 3 minutes) and 9:16 aspect ratio, so no Shorts button is needed.

steps.text: There is no Shorts button to select, because Youtube automatically identifies Shorts.
If your video is less than 3 minutes long and vertical (9:16 aspect ratio), it will automatically be posted as a Youtube Short.
To post it, open Content Studio > Post editor and select New draft, then select your YouTube account when scheduling.
